children: Andrew Macdonald, an Officer serving as President and Chief Operating Officer, reported purchases of common stock on September 4, 2026. The filing reports weighted-average prices of $75.6526 for 54,325 shares and $76.4425 for 15,675 shares. The total purchase amount reported is $5,308,063. After the transactions, Macdonald directly owned 426,320 shares of common stock.
